name: Stripe
description: Finance and Fintech: online payments infrastructure with APIs for payments, customers, subscriptions, billing and payouts.
access_notes: Anyone can sign up and get test-mode (sandbox) secret keys immediately with unrestricted sandbox access; live-mode keys are issued after self-serve account activation (business details), not a manual partner review. OAuth is used for Connect platform integrations and for the MCP server.
mcp_notes: Stripe hosts an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.stripe.com (OAuth or restricted-API-key bearer auth) plus a local @stripe/mcp package; Composio has a managed STRIPE toolkit with 432 tools.

evidence.note: 'The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests' via HTTP Basic Auth (key as username) or Bearer header; keys managed in the Dashboard.
'When you sign up for a Stripe account, we create three types of API keys for you'; test keys have unrestricted sandbox access, switching to live mode is done from the same API keys page.
Official Stripe MCP server hosted at https://mcp.stripe.com; OAuth recommended, restricted API key as bearer token supported.
Composio managed Stripe toolkit: Auth API_KEY/OAUTH2, 432 tools, 7 triggers, slug STRIPE.
'Receive Stripe events in your webhook endpoint' — register HTTPS endpoints (up to 16) for real-time event delivery.
